facts.fact: Niger's deputy secretary general of the Interior ministry announced a forthcoming National Population Register that will be interoperable with civil-status management systems, the biometric national card and travel documents.

NER.note: The RNP is to give a unique identifier to each citizen, but the document does not tie it to birth registration.

facts.fact: Niger created ANEI by decree n°2026-242 and announced a forthcoming National Population Register, a central secured database to give each citizen a unique identifier.
